name: @echelon-foundry/repository-operating-system
description: Self-contained Repository Operating System bootstrap for greenfield research and engineering projects.

scripts.test: node --test tests/npm-bootstrap.test.mjs tests/work-protocol.test.mjs tests/telemetry.test.mjs tests/ros-server.test.mjs tests/ros-hub.test.mjs tests/artifact-compatibility.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
scripts.test:fsharp: npm run build:fsharp && dotnet tests/Ros.Tests/bin/Release/net10.0/Ros.Tests.dll && node --test tests/artifact-fsharp-differential.test.mjs tests/git-fsharp-differential.test.mjs tests/work-fsharp-differential.test.mjs tests/work-telemetry-fsharp-differential.test.mjs tests/work-git-paths-fsharp-differential.test.mjs tests/work-attribution-fsharp-differential.test.mjs tests/work-backlog-validate-fsharp-differential.test.mjs tests/work-backlog-transition-fsharp-differential.test.mjs tests/work-capture-fsharp-differential.test.mjs tests/work-update-fsharp-differential.test.mjs tests/work-attach-fsharp-differential.test.mjs
scripts.release:check: npm run test:all && npm pack --dry-run && ./ros registry check && ./ros validate
